name: EPIC 212103522
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 5, 14.5 solar radii and 1.01 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 3,571 parsecs away, 15 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 1.01 solar masses and 14.5 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,331 K at its surface.
